how_to_execute.goal: Default boot on Pixel 10 Pro XL Chrome should fail WebGPU, take the one GL retry, report selected_backend webgl2, load scene-mobile.json, and present frames. Capture __webizenNativeInit and the served WASM digest. Do not mark qualified.
prerequisites: Keep the I5 WASM. Do not run cargo. Do not use tooling/native-host/build.ps1. Do not rebuild C:\github\synth\target.

Reuse the local world server if it is already serving this tree on 127.0.0.1:8800 (as of this packet: python -u C:/github/webizen-website/tooling/world_server.py --port 8800, PID 55180). Do not start a second copy. Do not use build.ps1.
steps: 1. Attach the Pixel 10 Pro XL with USB debugging enabled.
2. Install Android platform-tools if adb is missing. Confirm `adb devices -l` lists this Pixel (unauthorized devices are not attached).
3. The world server binds 127.0.0.1 only. On the host run: adb reverse tcp:8800 tcp:8800. Do not rebind the already-running server to 0.0.0.0 unless that server is one you started for this probe.
4. On the Pixel, open Chrome (not a desktop remote-debug tab pretending to be the phone).
5. Load http://127.0.0.1:8800/ with no ?webgl2=1. That is the default path: WebGPU attempt, then one GL retry if adapter/device fails before canvas claim.
6. Wait until window.__webizenNativeInit.state === "ready" or a bounded timeout. On timeout record execution_status not_executed or state refused. Never invent selected_backend "webgpu".

7. Record: location.href, innerWidth/innerHeight, requested, selected_backend from window.__webizenNativeInit, world.renderer, world.upload.assets_loaded, world.upload.total_triangles (mobile scene is 76 assets / 309098 source triangles), served runtime-identity.json wasm.sha256.
8. Expect selected_backend "webgl2" on this device. Expect scene-mobile.json (assets_loaded 76), not the 77-asset desktop scene.

9. Screenshot (css scale) plus console. Store under this evidence directory as pixel-10-pro-xl-chrome.png and pixel-10-pro-xl-chrome-console.txt. Fill this JSON in place: execution_status executed, url, viewport, selected_backend, init, artifacts.
10. Optional second load http://127.0.0.1:8800/?webgl2=1 as a force-GL confirmation. Still do not mark qualified.
11. chrome://inspect remote debugging from the desktop is allowed only as a capture aid. The page must actually run in Pixel Chrome.
12. Leave a pre-existing 8800 server running. Stop only a server you started. Do not commit. P00 remains the only accepted packet.
